name: context-saver
description: Refuses a main-agent Read over the token cap so a subagent reads the file and reports back.

isOn.title: On
isOn.description: Refuses main-agent reads over the cap.

ctx.title: Cap (k tokens)
ctx.description: The most tokens one main-agent Read may return, in thousands.

slices.title: Allow slices
slices.description: Lets a Read with offset and limit pass when that slice is under the cap.
